alt: 自然觀察隊注意到草叢和樹枝輕輕晃動，循著細微動靜看見一隻小鹿。
scene_prompt: 風吹草動 means a small sign or change that attracts attention and may signal something happening. On a calm modern nature walk, a child guide notices a tiny breeze ripple through tall grass and a single branch shift; the group pauses and looks carefully toward a small deer beginning to emerge from behind bushes. The subtle movement is the first clue. Show gentle wind moving only grass and leaves, while people react attentively. Safe, peaceful. Natural anatomy, exactly two arms and legs per person, feet grounded on path; plant motion subtle and coherent; forest perspective plausible.
style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration, landscape 3:2, delicate graphite pencil contours, soft watercolor and colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, natural muted colors. No words, text, logos or watermark.
